name: Dr Chris Phillips
title: Dr, General Practitioner (FRACGP, MBBS (Hons))
description: GP at Equinox, "a peer-led GP clinic for the trans & gender diverse (TGD) community" (Thorne Harbour Health). Equinox GPs start, continue and manage gender-affirming hormone therapy using the Informed Consent Model, alongside general practice and sexual health care. Bulk billed for all patients with a valid Medicare card. As of Oct 2026 HotDoc says Equinox has no capacity for new patients and the new-patient waitlist is closed.
specialties: Trans and gender diverse general practice, gender-affirming hormone therapy, sexual health

name: Dr Ingrid Bretherton
title: Dr, Endocrinologist (FRACP, PhD, MBBS)
description: Endocrinologist at Equinox Endocrinology, which provides "specialist hormone care for trans and gender diverse adults aged 18 and over across Victoria" - weekly, in person or telehealth, time-limited (max five visits per referral) before ongoing care returns to the GP. For people who have not yet started gender affirming hormone therapy, or already on hormones needing a one-off specialist consult. GP referral required; "all visits are bulk billed with no out of pocket costs" with Medicare.

name: The Centre Clinic
title: Clinic
address: Level 3, Victorian Pride Centre, 79-81 Fitzroy St
description: "The Centre Clinic is a GP clinic for the LGBTIQ+ community" run by Thorne Harbour Health: "Our GPs and nurse practitioners already understand the health needs of LGBTIQA+ people". LGBTIQA+ affirmative general practice services include "hormone and contraceptive injections", HIV specialist care, PrEP/PEP and sexual health. Mixed billing: bulk bills concession card holders, full-time students under 25 and children under 16; others pay a private fee. Very limited capacity for new patients. Practitioners listed on HotDoc: Dr Stephen Rowles (sexual health physician), Dr Andrew Song, Dr Peggy Wong, Dr Nick Oxenburgh, Dr Nan Presswell (GPs), Dr Olivia Larner, Dr Jess Walls (GP registrars), Mark Thompson (nurse practitioner) - none of their listings states gender-affirming hormone prescribing.
specialties: LGBTIQA+ general practice, HIV care, sexual health, hormone injections
